text: Novikombank (renamed NOVIKOM) is a subsidiary bank of the state corporation Rostec: Rostec became its majority shareholder in 2016, and since 2023 the bank has sat in Rostec's RT-Finans holding.

source.name: Rostec: НОВИКОМ: новое имя банка российских инженеров (archived copy of rostec.ru)
source.quote: АО АКБ «НОВИКОМБАНК», входящее в состав Госкорпорации Ростех
source.note: Translation: 'AO AKB NOVIKOMBANK, part of the Rostec State Corporation'. The article also says Rostec became its majority shareholder in 2016 and that since 2023 the bank is in the RT-Finans holding.

additionalSources.name: Council Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/581 (EUR-Lex), Annex IV entry for Novikombank
additionalSources.quote: Novikombank is a subsidiary of Rostec (Russian Technologies State Corporation)
